name: Gini — 12-month PD rank ordering
description: How well the PD model ranks obligors that go on to default above those that do not.
definition: Gini = 2 × AUC − 1, using each obligor's 12-month PD at the start of the window and defaults observed over the following 12 months (performing SME and corporate obligors).
data_source: Rating and PD history (CreditLens extract); default register

name: Default-rate back-test (observed ÷ predicted)
description: Whether predicted PDs match the default rate actually observed.
definition: Observed 12-month default rate of the cohort performing 12 months before period end ÷ the cohort's exposure-weighted average predicted 12-month PD.

name: Rating grades failing the binomial test
description: Grade-level calibration: grades where defaults are significantly higher than the grade PD implies.
definition: Number of rating grades whose observed default count exceeds the 99% one-sided binomial bound implied by the grade PD.

name: Rating distribution stability (PSI)
description: Whether today's portfolio still looks like the population the model was built on.
definition: PSI = Σ (actual% − expected%) × ln(actual% ÷ expected%) over rating grades, current portfolio against the development sample.

name: Exposure on fallback PD (%)
description: Exposure that gets no model PD because the obligor has no valid current rating.
definition: Exposure of obligors without a valid current rating, given the fallback PD ÷ total exposure in scope.
data_source: ECL input file; CreditLens rating dates

name: LGD back-test (realised ÷ predicted)
description: Whether predicted losses match the losses realised on closed workouts.
definition: Realised LGD on workouts closed in the last 12 months ÷ LGD predicted at the date of default.
data_source: Workout and recovery records; collateral register

name: Collateral valuations older than 12 months (%)
description: Stale collateral values overstate recoveries.
definition: Collateral value with a valuation date more than 12 months before period end ÷ total collateral value used in LGD.

name: CCF back-test (realised ÷ predicted EAD)
description: Whether undrawn commitments are drawn down at default as the model predicts.
definition: Realised exposure at default ÷ EAD predicted 12 months before default, facilities that defaulted in the last 12 months.
data_source: Facility limits and balances history; default register

name: Defaults drawn above the approved limit (%)
description: Drawings above limit at default point to a CCF floor that is too low or to limit-control gaps.
definition: Defaulted facilities whose drawn balance at default exceeded the approved limit ÷ defaulted facilities in the last 12 months.

name: Defaults not in Stage 2 twelve months before (%)
description: Tests whether the SICR criteria catch deterioration early — a default should normally pass through Stage 2 first.
definition: Obligors that defaulted in the last 12 months and were in Stage 1 twelve months before default ÷ all defaults in the last 12 months.

name: Stage 2 share of performing exposure (%)
description: Whether the Stage 2 population is moving outside the range expected for QDB's portfolio.
definition: Stage 2 exposure ÷ (Stage 1 + Stage 2) exposure at period end.

name: Stage 2 triggered only by the 30-day backstop (%)
description: A high share means the PD-based criteria are reacting late and the backstop is doing the work.
definition: Stage 2 exposure where the only SICR trigger met is 30+ days past due ÷ total Stage 2 exposure.

name: Manual staging overrides (%)
description: Reliance on judgement instead of the staging rules.
definition: Exposure whose stage was changed manually from the rule-based stage ÷ total exposure in scope.

name: Base-case GDP forecast error (pp)
description: How far the base scenario was from what actually happened.
definition: |Base-scenario forecast of Qatar real non-hydrocarbon GDP growth − published outturn (PSA)|, percentage points, for the quarter four quarters back.
data_source: Scenario set archive; PSA national accounts

name: Days since scenarios were last refreshed
description: Scenarios should be refreshed every quarter so the ECL reflects current conditions.
definition: Calendar days between period end and the approval date of the scenario set used in that period's ECL.

name: Weighted-to-base ECL uplift (%)
description: Checks that the weights produce a sensible non-linearity — neither none nor an extreme one.
definition: (Probability-weighted ECL − base-scenario ECL) ÷ base-scenario ECL.

name: Unexplained ECL movement (%)
description: The part of the quarter's ECL change that the ECL walk cannot explain.
definition: ECL movement not attributed to a driver (new business, repayments, stage transfers, risk parameters, macro, overlays) ÷ opening ECL.

name: Exposure reconciliation break to the ledger (%)
description: Completeness of the engine's input against the books.
definition: |Exposure in the ECL engine − general-ledger exposure| ÷ general-ledger exposure, in-scope portfolios at period end.

name: Post-model adjustments (% of ECL)
description: Growing overlays signal the models no longer capture the risk.
definition: Management overlays and post-model adjustments ÷ total reported ECL.

name: Gini — rating rank ordering
description: How well the scorecard ranks manufacturing obligors by default risk.
definition: Gini = 2 × AUC − 1 of the model grade against defaults over the following 12 months.

name: Rating overrides (%)
description: Frequent overrides mean users do not trust the model grade.
definition: Obligors whose approved grade differs from the model grade by one notch or more ÷ obligors rated in the period.

name: Ratings older than 12 months (%)
description: Stale ratings mean decisions and ECL use out-of-date risk.
definition: Obligors in scope whose last approved rating is more than 12 months old at period end ÷ obligors in scope.

name: Gini — rating rank ordering
description: How well the scorecard ranks services obligors by default risk.
definition: Gini = 2 × AUC − 1 of the model grade against defaults over the following 12 months.

name: Rating distribution stability (PSI)
description: Whether today's services portfolio still looks like the development population.
definition: PSI over rating grades, current portfolio against the development sample.

name: Rating overrides (%)
description: Frequent overrides mean users do not trust the model grade.
definition: Obligors whose approved grade differs from the model grade by one notch or more ÷ obligors rated in the period.

name: Realised vs priced margin variance (%)
description: Whether loans earn the risk-adjusted margin the model priced.
definition: |Realised net interest margin − margin priced by the model| ÷ priced margin, loans disbursed in the last 12 months.
data_source: Loan pricing records; finance margin report

name: Deals priced below the model floor (%)
description: Pricing exceptions erode the model's purpose.
definition: Loans disbursed in the period at a rate below the model's floor rate (approved exceptions) ÷ loans disbursed.

name: Gini — transaction score
description: How well the bank-statement score ranks applicants by default risk.
definition: Gini = 2 × AUC − 1 of the score at application against 12-month default.

name: Largest input-feature PSI
description: Drift in any input feature of a machine-learning model.
definition: Highest PSI across the model's input features, applications in the period against the development sample.

name: Approval-rate gap between customer segments (pp)
description: Fairness monitoring required for AI systems by the QCB AI Guideline.
definition: Largest difference in model-recommended approval rate between customer segments (sector, company age band, size band), percentage points.

name: Applications with insufficient statement history (%)
description: Applicants the model cannot score reliably.
definition: Applications with fewer than 6 months of bank-statement data ÷ applications scored.

name: Gini — bureau score (individuals)
description: How well the bureau score ranks individual guarantors and owners by default risk.
definition: Gini = 2 × AUC − 1 of the score against 12-month default.

name: Bureau hit rate (%)
description: Applicants the bureau cannot match get no score.
definition: Applicants matched to a credit bureau record ÷ applicants scored.

name: Gini — bureau score (corporates)
description: How well the corporate bureau score ranks companies by default risk.
definition: Gini = 2 × AUC − 1 of the score against 12-month default.

name: Bureau hit rate (%)
description: Companies the bureau cannot match get no score.
definition: Companies matched to a credit bureau record ÷ companies scored.

name: Actual ÷ modelled stressed outflow (%)
description: Whether real outflows approach what the stress model assumes.
definition: Largest actual 30-day net cash outflow in the period ÷ modelled 30-day stressed net outflow.
data_source: Treasury cash-flow report; stress test output
defined_by: Model Owner 3 (Head of Market & Liquidity Risk)

name: LCR forecast error (pp)
description: Accuracy of the liquidity projection.
definition: |Forecast LCR − actual LCR| at period end, forecast made one quarter earlier.
defined_by: Model Owner 3 (Head of Market & Liquidity Risk)

name: NII forecast error (%)
description: Accuracy of the net interest income projection.
definition: |Forecast NII − actual NII| ÷ actual NII for the quarter, forecast made one quarter earlier.
defined_by: Model Owner 3 (Head of Market & Liquidity Risk)

name: Deposit run-off back-test (actual ÷ assumed)
description: Whether non-maturity deposits behave as the behavioural assumption says.
definition: Actual run-off of non-maturity deposits in the last 12 months ÷ run-off assumed by the model.
defined_by: Model Owner 3 (Head of Market & Liquidity Risk)

name: Losses exceeding scenario severity (count)
description: A loss larger than the severe-but-plausible scenario means the scenario is understated.
definition: Internal and relevant external loss events in the last 12 months larger than the severe loss of the matching scenario.

name: Scenarios reviewed in the last 12 months (%)
description: Scenarios must be refreshed by the business each year.
definition: Scenarios with a business review dated in the last 12 months ÷ scenarios in the register.

name: High-risk customer share (%)
description: A share outside the expected range points to factor weights out of line with QDB's customers.
definition: Customers rated High risk ÷ active customers at period end.

name: Suspicious activity reports on low-risk customers (%)
description: If many reports concern customers rated Low risk, the rating misses risky customers.
definition: Suspicious activity reports filed in the last 12 months on customers rated Low risk at the time ÷ all reports filed.

name: Customer risk reviews overdue (%)
description: Overdue periodic reviews leave ratings stale.
definition: Customers whose periodic risk review is past due ÷ active customers.
